messages:
ana: Heads-up: onboarding run for q6b-int4 on retrieval pipeline flagged ~0.4% anchor mismatches vs golden. Not huge but weird pattern: top anchors reorder when doc snippets contain email-like tokens.
vik: Email-like tokens? maybe tokenization split changed. We switched to unified-tokenizer v2 on the retrieval path yesterday.
dmitri: Could also be truncation shift due to new KV cache alignment with shorter prefix handling.
nana: (typo) ana: sorry, meant ana.
nora: Quick repro: ran golden only eval with --golden=anchors_v2 and saw seed a1b2c lose top spot to unrelated snippet that had an email after the 2nd sentence.
vik: Repro command: ```bash
./tools/golden_eval --model q6b-int4 --subset anchors_v2 --output /tmp/q6b_anchor_diffs.json
```
dmitri: Can you paste one failing pair?
nana: ana: failing seed a1b2c: baseline rank1: 'Summary about product launch.' new rank1: 'Contact us at help@acme.com' 
nana: appears anchor selection favored short email-containing snippet when token boundaries moved.
label-ops: label-ops: creating batch LABEL-1601 (120 examples) for microgolden review, tagging @label-ops.
nora: Plan I'm proposing: 1) run tokenization diff between baseline and v2 on the failing seeds 2) compute fingerprint collisions (md5 of normalized token stream) 3) if mismatch > threshold, create mini-golden patch of 300 anchors and queue for 3-judge labels.
dmitri: Also run dedupe pass: many of these email snippets are low-quality duplicates from web scrape. If dedupe thresholds loosened they might surface.
vik: Good point. We recently relaxed de-dupe similarity threshold from 0.92 -> 0.9 to boost recall for long-tail. That could expose noisy anchors.
nana: ana: I'm going to run dedupe with previous threshold on the failing set to see if items drop out.
ci-bot: ci-bot: evaluation job 6132305690 finished. Artifacts: s3://ci/gold/q6b-int4/anchor-diffs/6132305690.json
label-ops: label-ops: batch LABEL-1601 created and assigned to project "microgolden_anchor_check". ETA 36h.
nora: If tokenization is the root cause we may need to: A) pin tokenizer in retrieval for q6b onboarding B) run token normalization on ingest C) add golden anchors with email-like tokens to improve coverage.
dmitri: I'm worried about the quant + tokenizer interaction. Int4 kernels can change token alignments for subword merges. We'll run a small kernel fallback test (q6b-int8) for comparison.
vik: I'll open ticket RW-8421 to track: include diffs, mini-golden plan, dedupe experiment. Assigning to @ana and @dmitri.
nana: ana: will start token-diff and dedupe-rollback test now and post /artifacts/tokdiff.json.
label-ops: label-ops: labeled 30/120 so far; marking early trends show 60% of flagged anchors are noise or duplicates.
nora: Good signal. If 60% are noise we should adjust ingestion dedupe and then re-evaluate model impact.
nana: ana: created mini-golden patch (patch-042) with 300 anchors, tag 'token-shift-check', pushed to s3://golden/patches/patch-042.json
vik: Thanks. Labelers will get context; once labels done we'll rerun the golden eval and compute anchor-preservation metric.
dmitri: ETA on rerun?
nana: ana: aiming for tomorrow EOD. I'll update RW-8421.
ci-bot: ci-bot: RW-8421 created and linked to artifacts at 6132305690.
